title: Fix Aggregator Empty Windows Plugin Instance Busy
description: Aggregator windows are empty. Error: [object Object] (see error.payload) payload={"tag":"message","val":"plugin instance busy"}. Diagnose and fix so Top + Perspective panes render content again.
summary:
Fixed empty Aggregator windows caused by a WASI P2 js-sys trap that poisoned the plugin instance guard.

**Root cause:** `puzzle3d_now_ms()` called `js_sys::Date::now()` on all wasm32, including wasm32-wasip2. Boot `setActiveExample(concrete-forest)` → precompute → panic (`cannot call wasm-bindgen imported functions on non-wasm targets`) → trap left `InstanceGuard` set → every later refresh returned `plugin instance busy` (shown as jco `[object Object] (see error.payload)`).

**Fix:** Gate `puzzle3d_now_ms` like the existing clock helpers (Instant on native/p2, Date only on wasm-bindgen web). Harden plugin runtime with UnsafeCell + WIT `clear-instance-guard` heal after traps, and teach JS busy detection to read jco `payload.val`. Filled new `WindowMeasure::Slider.reveal` fields so plugins compile.

**Verified:** Playwright on :6023 — no busy/unreachable errors, Top+Perspective canvases with Abbau Aufbau content; vitest busy-detection/serialize tests passed.
